reason: Thirty-six dollars for a lip balm from a brand I've never heard of, with no reviews, that I only saw in a Facebook ad? I've been burned that way before, and on my budget I'll stick with the drugstore balm that already keeps my lips from cracking.
objection: Anyone can promise a 365-day refund. Getting the money back is the hard part, and with no reviews I can't tell whether this company will even be around to honor it. I also don't know if that pink will look right on me.
would_change_my_mind: Real reviews from women my age with photos of the color on their lips, plus a cheaper single trial size, maybe around $15, so it wouldn't hurt if it didn't work out.
